objective: Supervise native transaction execution independently, prove controller exit before replacement, and reconcile uncertain outcomes without mutation replay.
decisions: Use the existing Child, HealthLink and RestartGate owners. The controller process isolates its transaction worker and writer lock.
Negotiate recovery.transaction and transaction-watch 0.1 only on the controller health channel. Started/armed precedes worker dispatch; finished follows actual join.
Start an independent absolute 5000 ms deadline on receipt of started. Heartbeat traffic cannot renew it; a finish at the deadline is late.
Latch protocol/order/clock failures. Quarantine the existing restart gate before termination and admit replacement only after native wait proves exact child exit.
Retain existing bounded backoff and three-restarts-per-60-second circuit across controller generations. Reopen storage under a fresh epoch and endpoint lifetime.
Exit the controller process on supervisor death or lease expiry without joining uncooperative work. Preserve unknown commit facts and recover via read-only reconciliation.
Verify actual worker tasks, independent pidfd exit observations, responsive client heartbeats and complete stored documents in seven native Linux scenarios.
Preserve the initial exhaustive GNOME event-switch build failure and reject supervision events on that unnegotiated renderer channel.
Keep W-08 and the complete five-family release open. Installed lifecycle/identity/policy, resource closure, native editing/activation and non-Linux supervision remain required.
